versions.content: {DRAFT} Values of IEEE1722TpAcfBus . busId per bus sys- tem The values for IEEE1722TpAcfBus . busId are defined per bus system in the scope of one IEEE1722TpAcfConnection . It is valid to define a transported IEEE1722TpAcfCan CAN bus with the iden- tical busId value as a transported IEEE1722TpAcfLin LIN bus in the same IEEE1722TpAcfConnection . The bus kind in combination with the busId is used to distinguish the messages.
